extracted.intended_audience: students, educators, and the general public seeking ethics education
extracted.subtask_description: Identify and understand the overconfidence bias as it appears in individual or organizational decision-making—how people overestimate their abilities or moral judgments relative to objective facts. Useful for analyzing ethical failures like those in corporate scandals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Overconfidence Bias
rubrics_metrics.description: The Overconfidence Bias is the tendency people have to be more confident in their own abilities, including making moral judgments, than objective facts would justify.
